what: GenAI-Rank prediction freeze (label-free; human_rating.json not opened)
undefined_score_rule: a method's undefined score (flagged failure: E with decomposition_failed, or no questions) is filled with one constant for all 9 candidates of that pool, so the official first-index tie rule selects candidate 0 - the same convention TIFA / DSG / PN-VQA already use for their own failures; fixed before any GenAI-Rank label is read
natural_ties_note: all-tied pools (a method's 9 scores equal) are counted per file; coarse scores (TIFA / DSG answer fractions) tie naturally; the official first-index rule applies, and the frozen scorer's 'official/mean' tie-expectation sensitivity covers them

sensitivity_common_defined_subset.rule: rescore the primary and attribution families without the pools where any of their methods has a flagged failure (E undefined after decomposition failure; no questions generated)
